text:
mia-cs: Heads up — Riverbank renewal (annual) lands next week. Finance is asking to switch payment from CC to Net30/wire and they want a short ratecard addendum to lock in the seat discount and a delegated-signer clause for procurement. Need legal + billing to weigh in before we send the DocuSign.

jordan-acct: Quick numbers pls — current ARR, seats, and proposed term/discount?

mia-cs: Current ARR $48,600 (270 seats). Proposed: 12mo Net30, same seat count, apply 7% committed discount effective at renewal. Customer verbally ok with term, procurement pushed payment method change.

sarah-legal: Draft language request: add a one-paragraph "Authorized Procurement Representative" clause that limits signer authority to payment and invoice acceptance only. Also confirm whether we need KYC language for wiring instructions (beneficial for EU customers). Can you drop the PO + draft addendum here? I can redline.

mike-finance: From finance POV: wiring is fine but we need vendor verification + VAT handling on the invoice. If they move to Net30 we must confirm billing entity (legal name, EIN) and update AR. Also note: we require credit-app for customers >$50k; this is close to the threshold.

ops-billing: FYI — for Net30 on Dedicated/reserved customers we typically require a credit-app and internal approval. If the billing entity or vendor code changes, update the subscription metadata before sending invoice to avoid disputes.

mia-cs: Billing entity confirmed: Riverbank Inc (US-EIN 12-3456789). Attaching draft PO and addendum (will upload shortly). @sarah-legal I'll send the redline request; @mike-finance please confirm whether we need credit-app in this case.

docsign-bot: DocuSign envelope created 1767771300 — "Riverbank Renewal Addendum" assigned to riverbank-procurement (external).

jordan-acct: Once legal greenlights the wording, send as "Sign and Return" only. If procurement pushes a different vendor code or wet-signature, loop CS -> finance -> legal. Keep it as lean as possible to avoid delay.

mia-cs: Plan: 1) legal redline by EOD today; 2) finance confirms wiring + credit-app requirement; 3) send DocuSign tomorrow morning with delegated-signer clause included. I'll log actions in Gainsight and flag renewal risk if any delays. :white_check_mark:

mike-finance: :thumbsup: will validate wiring and credit-app path once we have the legal redline.

sarah-legal: Will review addendum now, expect comments in-thread within a couple hours.

mia-cs: Thanks all — I’ll update once redline is in.
